title: centaurea lanceolata
intro: Centaurea lanceolata, commonly known as Lance Leaf Knapweed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea lanceolata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
